question: Compare the indexed evidence for the resident-individual tax-free threshold in AY 2025–26 and AY 2026–27 in a two-row table. Give each year’s source and calculate the difference only if both years are established; do not substitute a later schedule for a missing year.

requirements.description: Establish the resident-individual category and applicable assessment year for the 2025–26 threshold.
Establish the resident-individual category and applicable assessment year for the 2026–27 threshold.
Establish the resident-individual tax-free threshold for AY 2025–26 and its source.
Establish the resident-individual tax-free threshold for AY 2026–27 and its source.

checks.description: Establish the resident-individual category and applicable assessment year for the 2025–26 threshold.
checks.answerable_scope: The 2025–26 source covers natural persons other than non-resident individuals who are not Bangladeshi; this includes resident individuals.

checks.description: Establish the resident-individual category and applicable assessment year for the 2026–27 threshold.
checks.answerable_scope: The 2026–27 schedule covers individuals, including non-resident Bangladeshis; the accompanying exclusion is for non-residents in Bangladesh other than non-resident Bangladeshis, so resident individuals are covered.

checks.description: Establish the resident-individual tax-free threshold for AY 2025–26 and its source.
checks.answerable_scope: The NBR 2025–2026 circular states a zero-rate threshold of Tk 350,000 for 2025–26.

checks.description: Establish the resident-individual tax-free threshold for AY 2026–27 and its source.
checks.answerable_scope: The Finance Act 2026 schedule sets a zero-rate threshold of Tk 400,000 for 2026–27 and 2027–28; resident individuals are within its stated individual category.
